name: Deluge triggers Conduction on the enemies it hits (#12687)
contract: Every Deluge rank (806400, 807713-807717) reads 'Envelop enemies in the target area in water, dealing ... Frost
damage, triggering Conduction and reducing their attack power'. Conduction is 567560, a Frost direct-damage
spell on the target; the tooltip sets no condition on Conductive. Deluge's own effects are only damage and an
attack power debuff (806399), so nothing cast Conduction. A Stormbringer hit-result hook now casts it on each
enemy a non-triggered Deluge (family 22, SpellFamilyFlags1 bit 0x8000) damages. Brine 807105 is another
family-22 Frost hit without that bit and is the negative control. Deluge is instant and ground targeted, costs
50 Static (803102) and requires 'At Least 50 Static' (707050), so Static is set before each cast. Spell hit
rating forces every cast to land.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
